name: Thirty Days to Concur
title: Thirty Days to Concur
text: 7. You are called upon to respond to this notice within THIRTY DAYS of its receipt.

legal_basis.note: Sub-sections (4) and (5): where a party fails to act within thirty days of a request, the appointment may be made on an application to the court or the designated arbitral institution

statutory_reference: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 - S.11(4) and (5)
authoring_note:
Thirty days is the period after which the right to apply for a court appointment arises under Section 11(4) and (5). It is not a period the sender may shorten, and a notice giving fewer days will simply mean the application is premature.

As with the Section 138 notice, no calendar date is printed. The period runs from receipt, the notice is drafted before it is served, and a date computed from an assumed service date would understate the period the addressee actually has.
